## F-03  Invoices that chase themselves

Sweeps three registers daily - **TXN-004** commission approvals, **FIN-006** vendor invoices and **MKT-016** marketing vendor invoices - and sends a notice at **7, 30, 60 and 90 days**, then weekly after that.

The wording escalates with the age: DUE, FIRST, SECOND, FINAL. From 60 days it adds WhatsApp and Slack; at 90 the Director gets a copy of their own.

Moving the record to **Paid** stops it - there is nothing to cancel.

parameters.query: SELECT id, username, full_name, email, role FROM users WHERE active = 1;

WITH owed AS (
  SELECT 'TXN-004' AS form_code, 'Commission Approval' AS form_title,
         id, doc_no, COALESCE(status,'') AS status,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(transaction_ref,''), doc_no) AS reference,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(agent_name,''), '') AS owed_to,
         COALESCE(net_commission, 0)::numeric AS amount,
         NULLIF(payment_date,'') AS due_txt, created_at
  FROM frm_txn_004
  WHERE COALESCE(status,'') <> 'Paid'
    AND created_at ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'FIN-006', 'Vendor Invoice Verification',
         id, doc_no, COALESCE(status,''),
         COALESCE(NULLIF(invoice_no,''), doc_no),
         COALESCE(NULLIF(vendor_name,''), ''),
         COALESCE(invoice_amount, 0)::numeric,
         NULLIF(verification_date,''), created_at
  FROM frm_fin_006
  WHERE COALESCE(status,'') IN ('Pending','Verified','Disputed')
    AND created_at ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'MKT-016', 'Marketing Vendor Invoice',
         id, doc_no, COALESCE(status,''),
         COALESCE(NULLIF(invoice_no,''), doc_no),
         COALESCE(NULLIF(vendor_name,''), ''),
         0::numeric, NULL, created_at
  FROM frm_mkt_016
  WHERE COALESCE(status,'') IN ('Received','Verified','Approved for Payment','Disputed')
    AND created_at ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
)
SELECT form_code, form_title, id, doc_no, status, reference, owed_to, amount,
       due_txt,
       (CURRENT_DATE - substr(created_at, 1, 10)::date) AS age_days
FROM owed
WHERE (CURRENT_DATE - substr(created_at, 1, 10)::date) >= 7
ORDER BY age_days DESC;
